lessonsIntro: Sandsend is a beginner-friendly beach break, but we have not confirmed a school that teaches here. Whitby Surf School is a couple of miles south on West Cliff Beach.

text: The North York Moors National Park lists Sandsend as a good beach break for beginners. It is the northern end of the long stretch of sand that runs up from Whitby. We have not found a surf school that confirms it teaches at Sandsend, so for lessons the nearest option is Whitby Surf School on West Cliff Beach.

We could not confirm lifeguard cover or specific hazards at Sandsend. If you surf here without an instructor, go with friends, check the forecast and tide, and keep clear of the rocks and the becks that run out onto the beach.

text: The beaches on this stretch are mostly sandy beach breaks, so a long foam board is the right start, moving on to a hard mini-mal or longboard as you improve. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm wetsuits because the North Sea stays cold, and adds boots, gloves and hoods for the cooler months.
